meta.title: Rubrics
meta.description: Write and publish the judging rubric for each discipline of a competition.

adminRubrics.title: Rubrics
adminRubrics.lead: One rubric for each discipline. Schools can't start judging until every discipline has a published rubric.

denied.title: This page is for competition managers
denied.body: Your account doesn't manage this competition. If you need it for your work, ask a super admin for the competition manager role.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that competition
notFound.body: The link may be out of date, or the competition was never created.

noDiscipline.title: This competition doesn't run that discipline
noDiscipline.body: Rubrics are written only for the disciplines the competition runs.

index.missing: School judging can't start yet. These disciplines have no published rubric: {disciplines}.
index.held: The move into school judging was held back on {date}, and competition managers were told. It happens by itself once the last rubric is published.
index.ready: Every discipline has a published rubric, so school judging can start on time.
index.locked: School judging has started, so rubrics can no longer change.

discipline.title: {discipline} rubric
discipline.none: This discipline has no rubric yet. Start one from FOA's judging guide, then change it to suit the competition.
discipline.draftLead: Save as often as you like. Publishing needs at least one criterion and weights that add up to 100. A published rubric can't be changed, only replaced by a new version.
discipline.reviseLead: Start a new version from the published one. The published version stays in force until you publish the new one.
discipline.lockedNote: School judging has started, so this rubric can no longer change.

editor.label: Name
editor.newRowsHint: Fill in a new criterion below to add it. Save to get more empty rows.
editor.fixFields: Some criteria need fixing. Each one says what's wrong.
editor.tooMany: A rubric can have at most 10 criteria. Remove one before saving.

errors.out_of_range: This number is out of range.
errors.range_order: The highest score must be above the lowest score.

refusals.forbidden: Your account doesn't manage this competition.
refusals.not_found: This rubric no longer exists. Reload the page.
refusals.invalid_input: Something in the form couldn't be read. Check the criteria and try again.
refusals.rubric_not_editable: This version has been published, so it can't change. Reload the page.
refusals.rubric_locked_by_judging: School judging has started, so rubrics can no longer change.
refusals.rubric_exists: This discipline already has a rubric.
refusals.draft_exists: A new version is already being drafted.
refusals.not_published: Only a published rubric can be revised.
refusals.discipline_not_enabled: This competition doesn't run that discipline.
refusals.no_criteria: Add at least one criterion before publishing.
refusals.weights_total: The weights add up to {total}. They must add up to 100 before publishing.

done.label: Done
done.created: The draft is ready. It starts from FOA's judging guide.
done.published: The rubric is published. It can no longer change.
done.revision: A new version is ready to edit. The published version stays in force until you publish this one.
